This chapter is the configuration reference of the book: the build options that decide what is compiled, the
generated macros that fix the compiled alternatives, the five process-global numerics switches read from the
environment, the launch variables of the layout, the test-harness variables, the YAML[^rg-602bede77d0b] keys that select the
local schemes, and the matrix that says which switch combination a registered test exercises. The mechanisms
the switches select are described where they belong, in @sec-ch04, @sec-ch05 and @sec-ch06; here each switch
section keeps its selector, its default, its couplings and guards, and the registered evidence, and points at
its home for the derivation. No solver run is reported in this chapter; the independent checks of the
chapter's contracts are the script `src/snapy_report/ch12/configuration_check.py` with its committed output,
and the solver tests are catalogued with their assertions in @sec-ch15-ch12-tests.

The five numerics switches are environment variables, written in the figures and tables of this chapter by
two-letter abbreviations: WB[^rg-8cb4b02fa280] is `SNAP_WB_REF4`, XC `SNAP_X1_CENTROID_EXACT`, MC[^rg-52dc4b39bbdc] `SNAP_X1_MASS_COVARIANCE`, FC
`SNAP_FLUX_COVARIANCE` and RE `SNAP_GRAVITY_WORK_RADIAL_EXACT`. WB, XC and MC are off by default, FC and RE are on, and
XC turns WB on.

```{python}
#| label: fig-ch12-dependencies
#| fig-cap: "Configuration dependencies: XC implies WB; gravity activates ghost/cell guards; face mode and geometry gate corrected work. Boxes state predicates, not performance results."
#| fig-alt: "Centroid implies reference; gravity activates minimum stencil guards; radial work needs face mode and supported geometry."
#| echo: false
from snapy_report.ch12.fig_dependencies import make_fig
make_fig()
```
